tool_paths.command: for t in dc_shell dct_shell design_vision icc_shell pt_shell lc_shell vcs urg; do command -v "$t" || true; done; find /opt/Synopsys /opt/synopsys /usr/local -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -name dc_shell -o -name design_vision -o -name icc_shell -o -name pt_shell -o -name lc_shell \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 60

technology_candidates.command: timeout 45s find /home/IC /opt /usr/local -maxdepth 7 \( -name .ssh -o -name .cache -o -name .git -o -name cov.vdb -o -name runs -o -name .mozilla -o -name .config -o -name .local -o -name .gnome2 -o -name .gconf \) -prune -o -type f \( -name "*.tf" -o -name "*.tluplus" -o -name "*.tlup" -o -name "*.db" -o -name "*.lib" -o -name "*.lef" -o -name "*tech2itf*" \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 260

reference_flow_candidates.command: timeout 40s find /home/IC/Desktop /home/IC/Document /home/IC/Documents /opt/Synopsys -maxdepth 6 \( -name .git -o -name cov.vdb -o -name runs -o -name .ssh \) -prune -o -type f \( -name "*.tcl" -o -name "*.sdc" -o -name ".synopsys_dc.setup" -o -name ".synopsys_icc.setup" -o -name "*icc*readme*" \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 180; for p in /home/IC/.synopsys_dc.setup /home/IC/.synopsys_icc.setup; do if test -f "$p"; then printf "\nSETUP_PATH %s\n" "$p"; grep -E "(target_library|link_library|search_path|mw_reference|tech_file|tlu|\.db|\.tf)" "$p" | head -n 35; fi; done

physical_library_candidates.command: timeout 35s find /home/IC /opt -maxdepth 7 \( -name .ssh -o -name .cache -o -name .git -o -name cov.vdb -o -name runs -o -name .mozilla -o -name .config -o -name .local \) -prune -o \( -type d \( -name FRAM -o -name CEL -o -name milkyway -o -iname "*smic*" -o -iname "*saed*" -o -iname "*tsmc*" -o -iname "*nangate*" \) -o -type f -name lib \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 130

scope: bounded inventory only; executable paths do not prove licenses or usable process libraries
